verdict.headline: NOT YET - no statistically clear edge; the fix behaves like an ordinary price level so far.
details: At the fix level price bounced 36% of the time (363 touches) vs 41% at placebo levels (-5 pts, p=0.0868).
Magnet beta: fix 0.0065 (t=0.53) vs placebo 0.0069 (t=0.69). Negative = price pulled back toward the level.
